supporting_observations.claim: The repeated failures target svc-grades and originate from FILE-ORC-01 at 10.56.20.20; the FILE-ORC-01 events report the same process name and PID throughout the sampled activity.
Failures recur at roughly one-minute intervals from 13:33 through 13:48 UTC, consistent with the supplied inventory description that GradeSync runs every minute and re-authenticates each run.

The failures report bad-password status, and the first observed failure is shortly after the supplied 13:30 UTC scheduled svc-grades password rotation. This timing and cadence support a stale GradeSync credential as the likely explanation.
The supplied records show failed authentication attempts; they do not show a successful svc-grades authentication during this activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The records show authentication outcomes and process metadata, but do not identify the application or job making the requests.
The supplied change calendar gives a scheduled rotation time but does not establish that the password was actually changed then or that GradeSync was subsequently updated.
The provided records cover the listed failures; they do not establish whether authentication activity occurred outside the supplied evidence.
claims_not_established: That the scheduled password rotation was completed at 13:30 UTC.
That GradeSync, rather than another process on FILE-ORC-01, generated every failed attempt.
Whether the job was updated and later resumed successfully.
